output.headline: Ironvale Edge Past Northgate 1-0
output.text: Ironvale Athletic’s direct counter paid off when Zeke Mbeki finished a 2‑m shot at 26:09 (xg 0.829) after a 1‑pass build‑up. Northgate’s patient possession was broken early (momentum swing –65 at 05:59) but Ironvale’s 47% possession and 8.8 PPDA kept the pressure. The goal shifted momentum to 27 and 30 in the 61st and 67th minutes, while Northgate’s 53% possession and 7.9 PPDA failed to convert. Mbeki’s 1‑goal, 1.39 xg and 57 passes completed sealed the win.
